verses.1:1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.1:2: This One was in the beginning with God.
verses.1:3: All things came into being through Him, and without Him nothing came into being that has been made.
verses.1:4: In Him there was life, and the life was the light of mankind;
verses.1:5: and the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not grasp it.
verses.1:6: There was a man who was sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.1:7: This man came for testimony, so that he might bear witness about the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.1:8: That man was not the light, but came so that he might bear witness about the light.
verses.1:9: That was the true light, which enlightens every person coming into this world.
verses.1:10: He was in the world, and the world was made through Him, yet the world did not know Him.
verses.1:11: He came to His own possessions, and His own people did not receive Him.
verses.1:12: Yet to as many as received Him, He gave authority to become sons of God, to those who believe in His name,
verses.1:13: who were born not from bloodlines, nor from the will of the flesh, nor from the will of a man, but from God.
verses.1:14: And the Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us; and we saw His glory, glory as of the only-begotten from the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.1:15: John bears witness about Him and cries out, saying, "This was the One of whom I said, 'The One who is going to come after me has been placed ahead of me, because He was before me.'"
verses.1:16: And from His fullness all of us have received, even grace for grace;
verses.1:17: because the Law was given through Moses, while grace and truth came into being through Jesus Christ.
verses.1:18: No one has ever seen God; the only-begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He Himself has made Him known.
verses.1:19: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to him to ask him, "Who are you?"
verses.1:20: And he confessed and did not deny, and he confessed, "I am not the Christ."
verses.1:21: And they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" And he said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."
verses.1:22: Therefore they said to him, "Who are you, so that we may give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"
verses.1:23: He said, "I am the voice of one crying out in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord,' just as Isaiah the prophet said."
verses.1:24: And those who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.1:25: And they asked him and said to him, "Why then do you baptize, if you are neither the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
verses.1:26: John answered them, saying, "I baptize in water; yet there has stood in your midst One whom you do not know.
verses.1:27: He Himself is the One who is going to come after me, who has been placed ahead of me, the strap of whose sandal I am not worthy to untie."
verses.1:28: These things happened in Bethany across the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.1:29: On the next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and he said, "Look, the Lamb of God; look, the One who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.1:30: This is the One about whom I said, 'After me comes a man who has been placed ahead of me, because He was before me.'
verses.1:31: And I did not know Him, yet so that He might be revealed in Israel, for this reason I came baptizing in water."
verses.1:32: And John bore witness, saying, "I saw the Spirit descending like a dove from heaven, and He remained upon Him.
verses.1:33: And I did not know Him; yet the One who sent me to baptize in water, that One said to me, 'The One upon whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining upon Him, this is the One who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.'
verses.1:34: And I have seen and borne witness that this is the Son of God."
verses.1:35: On the next day John was standing again with two of his disciples.
verses.1:36: And looking at Jesus as He walked, he says, "Look, the Lamb of God!"
verses.1:37: And the two disciples heard him speaking, and they followed Jesus.
verses.1:38: Then Jesus turned and, seeing them following Him, says to them, "What are you seeking?" They said to Him, "Rabbi (which translated means Teacher), where are You staying?"
verses.1:39: He says to them, "Come and see." They came and saw where He was staying, and they remained with Him that day; now the hour was about the tenth.
verses.1:40: Now Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two who had heard from John and had followed Him.
verses.1:41: He first finds his own brother Simon and says to him, "We have found the Messiah (which is translated Christ)."
verses.1:42: And he brought him to Jesus. Looking intently at him, Jesus said, "You are Simon, son of Jonah; you will be called Cephas," which is translated Peter.
verses.1:43: On the following day He wanted to depart for Galilee, and He finds Philip. And Jesus says to him, "Follow Me."
verses.1:44: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.1:45: Philip finds Nathanael and says to him, "We have found the One about whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets also: Jesus, son of Joseph, from Nazareth."
verses.1:46: And Nathanael said to him, "From Nazareth can anything good be?" Philip says to him, "Come and see."
verses.1:47: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him and says about him, "Look, truly an Israelite in whom there is no deceit!"
verses.1:48: Nathanael says to Him, "From where do You know me?" Jesus answered and said to him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
verses.1:49: Nathanael answered Him and said, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God; You are the King of Israel!"
verses.1:50: Jesus answered and said to him, "Because I said to you, 'I saw you under the fig tree,' you believe; you will see greater things than these."
verses.1:51: And He says to him, "Amen, amen, I tell you, you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending above the Son of Man."
verses.2:1: And on the third day a wedding took place in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.
verses.2:2: Now Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding as well.
verses.2:3: And when the wine gave out, the mother of Jesus said to Him, "They have no wine."
verses.2:4: And Jesus said to her, "What is it to Me and to you, woman? My hour has not yet come."
verses.2:5: His mother said to the attendants, "Whatever He tells you, do it."
verses.2:6: Now six stone water jars were placed there according to the purification of the Jews, each holding two or three measures.
verses.2:7: Jesus said to them, "Fill the water jars with water." And they filled them all the way to the top.
verses.2:8: And Jesus said to them, "Draw some out now, and bring it to the banquet master." And they brought it.
verses.2:9: Now when the banquet master tasted the water that had become wine, and did not know where it was from (though the attendants who had drawn the water knew), the banquet master called the bridegroom,
verses.2:10: and said to him, "Every man sets out the good wine first, and once they have become drunk, then that which is inferior. You, however, have saved the good wine up to now."
verses.2:11: Jesus performed this, the beginning of signs, in Cana of Galilee; and He made His glory manifest, and His disciples believed in Him.
verses.2:12: After this He Himself, and His mother, and His brothers, and His disciples went down to Capernaum; and there they remained not many days.
verses.2:13: And the Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
verses.2:14: and He found in the temple those selling oxen, and sheep, and doves, and the money changers seated.
verses.2:15: And when He had made something like a whip out of cords, He drove them all out of the temple, the sheep also, and the oxen; and He poured out the coins of the money changers, and overturned the tables.
verses.2:16: And to those who were selling doves He said, "Take these things away from here, and do not make the house of My Father a house of commerce."
verses.2:17: Then His disciples remembered that it is written, "Zeal for Your house has consumed Me."
verses.2:18: So the Jews answered and said to Him, "What sign do You show us, since You do these things?"
verses.2:19: Jesus answered and said to them, "Tear down this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
verses.2:20: Therefore the Jews said, "In forty-six years this temple was built, and will You raise it up in three days?"
verses.2:21: He, however, was speaking of the temple of His body.
verses.2:22: Therefore, when He had risen from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had been saying this, and they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus spoke.
verses.2:23: Now while He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, on the feast day, many believed in His name, seeing His signs that He was performing.
verses.2:24: Jesus Himself, however, was not entrusting Himself to them, because He Himself knew all people,
verses.2:25: and because He had no need that anyone bear witness concerning man, for He Himself knew what was within man.
verses.3:1: Now there was a man from the Pharisees, Nicodemus by name, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.3:2: This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know that You have come from God as a teacher, for no one can perform these signs that You perform unless God is with him."
verses.3:3: Jesus answered and said to him, "Amen, amen, I tell you, unless someone is reborn anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God."
verses.3:4: Nicodemus said to Him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he really enter into his mother's womb a second time and be reborn?"
verses.3:5: Jesus answered, "Amen, amen, I tell you, unless someone is reborn from water and the Holy Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.3:6: What has been born from the flesh is flesh, and what has been born from the Spirit is spirit.
verses.3:7: Do not be astonished that I said to you, 'You must be born anew.'
verses.3:8: The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear its sound, yet you do not know where it comes from or where it goes; so is everyone who has been born from the Spirit."
verses.3:9: Nicodemus answered and said to Him, "How can these things happen?"
verses.3:10: Jesus answered and said to him, "You are a teacher in Israel, and you do not know these things?
verses.3:11: Amen, amen, I tell you that we speak what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and you do not receive our testimony.
verses.3:12: If I have spoken earthly things to you and you do not believe, how will you believe if I speak heavenly things to you?
verses.3:13: And no one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verses.3:14: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, in the same way the Son of Man must be lifted up,
verses.3:15: so that everyone who believes in Him may not perish, but may have eternal life.
verses.3:16: For God loved the world in such a way that He gave His only-begotten Son, so that everyone who believes in Him may not perish, but may have eternal life.
verses.3:17: For God did not send His Son into the world that He might judge the world, but that the world might be saved through Him.
verses.3:18: The one who believes in Him is not judged; the one who does not believe, however, has already been judged, because he does not believe in the name of the only-begotten Son of God.
verses.3:19: Now this is the judgment: that the light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness more than the light, for their works were evil.
verses.3:20: For everyone who does evil hates the light and does not come to the light, so that his works may not be reproved;
verses.3:21: yet the one who does the truth comes to the light, so that his works may be made manifest, because they have been done in God."
verses.3:22: After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea, and there He was staying with them and was baptizing.
verses.3:23: Now John also was baptizing in Aenon, near Salim, because many waters were there, and people were coming and being baptized.
verses.3:24: For John had not yet been put into prison.
verses.3:25: Now a dispute arose on the part of John's disciples with the Jews concerning purification.
verses.3:26: And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, the One who was with you across the Jordan, to whom you bore witness, look, He is baptizing, and everyone is coming to Him."
verses.3:27: John answered and said, "A man cannot receive anything unless it has been given to him from heaven.
verses.3:28: You yourselves bear witness for me that I said, 'I am not the Christ,' but that I have been sent ahead of Him.
verses.3:29: The one who has the bride is the bridegroom; the friend of the bridegroom, however, who stands and hears him, rejoices with joy because of the bridegroom's voice. Therefore this joy of mine has been fulfilled.
verses.3:30: He must increase, while I must decrease.
verses.3:31: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth is from the earth, and speaks from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.3:32: And what He has seen and heard, to this He testifies, and no one receives His testimony.
verses.3:33: The one who has received His testimony has set his seal that God is truthful.
verses.3:34: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God does not give the Spirit by measure.
verses.3:35: The Father loves the Son and has given everything into His hand.
verses.3:36: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; yet the one who disbelieves the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains upon him."
verses.4:1: Therefore, when Jesus came to know that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus makes and baptizes more disciples than John
verses.4:2: (although Jesus was not baptizing, but His disciples were),
verses.4:3: He left Judea and went away again into Galilee.
verses.4:4: Now it was necessary for Him to pass through Samaria.
verses.4:5: Therefore He came to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near the plot of land that Jacob gave to Joseph his son.
verses.4:6: Now Jacob's spring was there. Therefore Jesus, tired from the journey, was sitting thus by the spring. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.4:7: A woman from Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give Me a drink."
verses.4:8: (For His disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.)
verses.4:9: Therefore that Samaritan woman said to Him, "How do You, being a Jew, ask a drink from me, who am a Samaritan woman?" For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.
verses.4:10: Jesus answered and said to her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, 'Give Me a drink,' you would perhaps have asked Him, and He would have given you living water."
verses.4:11: The woman said to Him, "Sir, You have nothing with which to draw, and the well is deep; where then do You get living water?
verses.4:12: Surely You are not greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and himself drank from it, and his sons, and his livestock?"
verses.4:13: Jesus answered and said to her, "Everyone who drinks from this water will be thirsty again; but the one who drinks from the water that I will give him will never be thirsty;
verses.4:14: instead, the water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water leaping up into eternal life."
verses.4:15: The woman said to Him, "Sir, give me this water, so that I may not be thirsty, nor come here to draw."
verses.4:16: Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."
verses.4:17: The woman answered and said, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You have spoken well, 'I have no husband';
verses.4:18: for you have had five husbands, and the one you have now is not your husband; you have spoken this truthfully."
verses.4:19: The woman said to Him, "Sir, I see that You are a prophet.
verses.4:20: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where one must worship."
verses.4:21: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe Me that the hour is coming when neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.4:22: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, because salvation is from the Jews.
verses.4:23: Yet the hour is coming, and now is, when true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth. For the Father also seeks such people to worship Him.
verses.4:24: God is spirit, and it is necessary for those who worship Him to worship in spirit and truth."
verses.4:25: The woman said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming (who is called Christ); so when He comes, He will declare all things to us."
verses.4:26: Jesus said to her, "I am He, the One speaking with you."
verses.4:27: And immediately His disciples came, and they were marveling that He was speaking with a woman. Yet no one said, "What are You seeking?" or, "Why are You speaking with her?"
verses.4:28: Therefore the woman left her water jar and went away into the city, and said to those people,
verses.4:29: "Come and see a man who told me everything I have done; could He be the Christ?"
verses.4:30: Therefore they went out from the city and were coming to Him.
verses.4:31: Meanwhile the disciples were urging Him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."
verses.4:32: But He said to them, "I have food to eat that you do not know."
verses.4:33: So the disciples were saying to one another, "Surely no one brought Him anything to eat?"
verses.4:34: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, to complete His work.
verses.4:35: Do you not say that there are still four months, and the harvest comes? Look, I say to you, lift up your eyes and see the fields, for they are already white for harvest.
verses.4:36: And the one who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit for eternal life, so that both the one who sows and the one who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.4:37: For in this the saying is true: it is one who sows, and another who reaps.
verses.4:38: I sent you to reap what you did not labor for; others have labored, and you have entered into their labors."
verses.4:39: Now from that city many of the Samaritans believed in Him because of the word of the woman testifying, "He told me everything I have done."
verses.4:40: Therefore, when the Samaritans came to Him, they urged Him to stay there. And He stayed there two days.
verses.4:41: And many more believed in Him because of His word.
verses.4:42: And they were saying to the woman, "No longer do we believe because of your speech; for we ourselves have heard, and we know that this One is truly the Savior of the world."
verses.4:43: Now after two days He went out from there and went away into Galilee.
verses.4:44: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own homeland.
verses.4:45: Therefore, when He came into Galilee, the Galileans received Him, since they had seen all the things that He had done in Jerusalem at the feast; for they themselves had also come to the feast.
verses.4:46: So He came again to Cana of Galilee, where He made the water wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.4:47: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived from Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and was urging Him to come down and heal his son, for he was beginning to die.
verses.4:48: Therefore Jesus said to him, "Unless you see signs and wonders, you do not believe."
verses.4:49: The royal official said to Him, "Sir, come down before my son dies."
verses.4:50: Jesus said to him, "Go; your son lives." The man believed the word that Jesus said to him, and set out.
verses.4:51: Now while he was already going down, the servants met him and reported, saying that his son was living.
verses.4:52: Therefore he inquired from them the hour at which he had become better. And they said to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."
verses.4:53: Therefore the father realized that it was that hour at which Jesus said to him, "Your son lives"; and he himself believed, and his entire household.
verses.4:54: This again Jesus did as the second sign, when He had come from Judea into Galilee.
verses.5:1: After these things, there was a feast day of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.5:2: Now there is in Jerusalem a sheep pool, which in Hebrew is called Bethsaida, having five porticoes.
verses.5:3: In these lay a great multitude of the sick, the blind, the lame, and the withered, waiting for the movement of the water.
verses.5:4: Now an angel of the Lord went down into the pool at certain times, and the water was moved. And whoever went down first into the pool after the movement of the water was made well from whatever infirmity held him.
verses.5:5: Now a certain man was there who had been in his infirmity for thirty-eight years.
verses.5:6: Now when Jesus saw this man lying there, and realized that he had already been that way for a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to become well?"
verses.5:7: The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I do not have a man to put me into the pool when the water is disturbed; for while I am coming, another goes down before me."
verses.5:8: Jesus said to him, "Rise, pick up your cot, and walk."
verses.5:9: And immediately that man became well, and he picked up his cot and began walking. Now on that day it was the Sabbath.
verses.5:10: Therefore the Jews were saying to the one who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath; it is not lawful for you to carry your cot."
verses.5:11: He answered them, "The One who made me well, He said to me, 'Pick up your cot and walk.'"
verses.5:12: Therefore they questioned him, "Who is that man who said to you, 'Pick up your cot and walk'?"
verses.5:13: Now the one who had been made well did not know who He was, for Jesus had withdrawn from the crowd present in that place.
verses.5:14: Later Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, "Look, you have been made well; do not sin any longer, so that something worse does not happen to you."
verses.5:15: That man went away and reported to the Jews that it was Jesus who made him well.
verses.5:16: On this account, the Jews were persecuting Jesus, because He was doing these things on the Sabbath.
verses.5:17: But Jesus replied to them, "My Father is working up to now, and I am working."
verses.5:18: On this account, therefore, the Jews were seeking even more to kill Him, because He was not only breaking the Sabbath, but also calling God His own Father, making Himself equal to God. So Jesus answered and said to them:
verses.5:19: "Amen, amen, I tell you, the Son is not able to do anything on His own, except what He sees the Father doing; for whatever He does, these things the Son likewise does.
verses.5:20: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him everything that He Himself does; and He will show Him works greater than these, so that you may be amazed.
verses.5:21: For just as the Father raises up the dead and gives life, so too the Son gives life to those whom He wills.
verses.5:22: For neither does the Father judge anyone, but He gave all judgment to the Son,
verses.5:23: in order that all may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father; the one who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
verses.5:24: Amen, amen, I tell you that the one who hears My word and believes the One who sent Me has eternal life, and does not come into judgment, but has crossed over from death into life.
verses.5:25: Amen, amen, I tell you that the hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who have heard will live.
verses.5:26: For as the Father has life within Himself, so He also gave the Son to have life within Himself;
verses.5:27: and He gave Him authority to pass judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
verses.5:28: Do not be amazed at this, because an hour is coming in which all who are in the tombs will hear the voice of the Son of God,
verses.5:29: and they will come forth: those who have done good to a resurrection of life, but those who have committed evil to a resurrection of judgment.
verses.5:30: I am not able to do anything on My own. Just as I hear, so I judge; and My judgment is just, because I do not seek My will, but the will of the One who sent Me.
verses.5:31: If I bear testimony about Myself, My testimony is not true.
verses.5:32: There is Another who bears testimony about Me, and I know that the testimony He bears about Me is true.
verses.5:33: You sent to John, and he bore testimony to the truth.
verses.5:34: Yet I do not receive testimony from a human being; rather, I say these things in order that you may be saved.
verses.5:35: He was a burning and shining lamp, yet you were willing for an hour to exult in his light.
verses.5:36: But I have a testimony greater than John's. For the works that the Father gave Me so that I might complete them, the very works themselves that I do, bear testimony about Me that the Father sent Me.
verses.5:37: And the Father who sent Me, He Himself bore testimony about Me. Neither have you ever heard His voice, nor have you seen His appearance,
verses.5:38: and you do not have His word remaining in you, because you do not believe the One whom He sent.
verses.5:39: You search the Scriptures, because you suppose that you have eternal life in them; and those are the ones that bear testimony about Me,
verses.5:40: and yet you do not want to come to Me so that you may have life.
verses.5:41: I do not receive renown from people.
verses.5:42: But I have come to know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
verses.5:43: I have come in the name of My Father, and you do not receive Me; if someone else comes in his own name, that one you will receive.
verses.5:44: How are you able to believe, you who receive glory from one another and do not seek the glory that is from God alone?
verses.5:45: Do not suppose that I am going to accuse you before the Father; there is one who accuses you, Moses, in whom you hope.
verses.5:46: For if you believed Moses, you would perhaps believe Me as well; for he wrote about Me.
verses.5:47: If, however, you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"
verses.6:1: After these things, Jesus departed across the Sea of Galilee, which is that of Tiberias.
verses.6:2: And a great multitude was following Him, because they were seeing the signs that He was performing upon those who were ill.
verses.6:3: So Jesus went up onto the mountain, and there He was sitting with His disciples.
verses.6:4: Now the Passover, the feast day of the Jews, was near.
verses.6:5: Therefore, when Jesus had raised His eyes and saw that a very great multitude was coming to Him, He said to Philip, "Where will we buy bread so that these people may eat?"
verses.6:6: Now He was saying this, testing him, for He Himself knew what He was going to do.
verses.6:7: Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not enough for them, so that each one may receive a small amount."
verses.6:8: One of His disciples, Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, said to Him,
verses.6:9: "There is one boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish; but what are these among so many?"
verses.6:10: Jesus therefore said, "Have the people recline." Now there was abundant grass in the place. So the men reclined, numbering about five thousand.
verses.6:11: So Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks, He distributed them to those who were reclining, and in the same way also from the fish, as much as they wished.
verses.6:12: Now when they were filled, He said to His disciples, "Gather the fragments that were left over, so that they may not be lost."
verses.6:13: Therefore they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the fragments from the five barley loaves that remained over from those who had eaten.
verses.6:14: So when those people had seen the sign that Jesus had performed, they were saying, "This One is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world."
verses.6:15: Jesus therefore, when He had realized that they were about to come to seize Him and make Him king, fled again to the mountain Himself alone.
verses.6:16: Now when it became evening, His disciples went down to the sea.
verses.6:17: And after they had boarded a boat, they came across the sea to Capernaum; and darkness had already fallen, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.6:18: Now the sea, with a great wind blowing, was rising up.
verses.6:19: Therefore, when they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking upon the sea and coming close to the boat, and they became afraid.
verses.6:20: But He said to them, "It is I; do not fear."
verses.6:21: Therefore they wanted to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat was at the land to which they were going.
verses.6:22: On the next day, the crowd that was standing on the other side of the sea saw that no other small boat was there except one, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with His disciples, but His disciples alone had departed.
verses.6:23: However, other boats arrived from Tiberias near the place where they ate the bread after the Lord gave thanks.
verses.6:24: Therefore, when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they boarded the small boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.6:25: And when they had found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You come here?"
verses.6:26: Jesus answered them and said, "Amen, amen, I tell you, you are seeking Me not because you saw signs, but because you ate from the loaves and were satisfied.
verses.6:27: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for that which endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For God the Father has sealed Him."
verses.6:28: So they said to Him, "What shall we do to work the works of God?"
verses.6:29: Jesus replied and said to them, "This is the work of God: that you believe in Him whom He sent."
verses.6:30: Therefore they said to Him, "What sign, then, do You perform, so that we may see and believe You? What work do You do?
verses.6:31: Our fathers ate manna in the desert, just as it is written, 'Bread from heaven He gave them to eat.'"
verses.6:32: Jesus therefore said to them, "Amen, amen, I tell you, Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but My Father is giving you the true bread from heaven.
verses.6:33: For the bread of God is that which descends from heaven and gives life to the world."
verses.6:34: So they said to Him, "Lord, give us this bread always."
verses.6:35: Now Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life; the one who comes to Me will not hunger, and the one who believes in Me will never thirst.
verses.6:36: But I have told you that you have even seen Me, and you do not believe.
verses.6:37: Everything that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will not cast out.
verses.6:38: For I descended from heaven, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
verses.6:39: Now this is the will of Him who sent Me, the Father: that from everything He has given Me I lose nothing, but raise it up on the last day.
verses.6:40: And this is the will of My Father, who sent Me: that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day."
verses.6:41: Therefore the Jews were murmuring about Him, because He had said, "I am the living bread who descended from heaven."
verses.6:42: And they were saying, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How, then, does He say, 'I descended from heaven'?"
verses.6:43: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, "Do not murmur among yourselves.
verses.6:44: No one is able to come to Me unless the Father, who sent Me, draws him, and I will raise him up on the last day.
verses.6:45: It is written in the prophets, 'And all will be taught by God.' Everyone who has heard from the Father and learned comes to Me.
verses.6:46: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except Him who is from God; this One has seen the Father.
verses.6:47: Amen, amen, I tell you, the one who believes in Me has eternal life.
verses.6:48: I am the bread of life.
verses.6:49: Your fathers ate manna in the desert, and they died.
verses.6:50: This is the bread descending from heaven, so that if anyone eats from it, he may not die.
verses.6:51: I am the living bread who descended from heaven.
verses.6:52: If anyone eats from this bread, he will live forever; and the bread that I will give is My flesh for the life of the world."
verses.6:53: Therefore the Jews were disputing with one another, saying, "How is this man able to give us His flesh to eat?"
verses.6:54: Jesus therefore said to them, "Amen, amen, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you will not have life in yourselves.
verses.6:55: The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.
verses.6:56: For My flesh truly is food, and My blood truly is drink.
verses.6:57: The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
verses.6:58: Just as the living Father sent Me, and I live on account of the Father, so the one who eats Me, he too will live on account of Me.
verses.6:59: This is the bread that descended from heaven, not as your fathers ate manna and died. The one who eats this bread will live forever."
verses.6:60: He said these things while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
verses.6:61: Many of His disciples, therefore, on hearing it, said, "This saying is hard, and who is able to listen to it?"
verses.6:62: Now Jesus, knowing within Himself that His disciples were murmuring about this, said to them, "Does this offend you?
verses.6:63: What, then, if you see the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?
verses.6:64: The Spirit is the One who gives life; the flesh is of no benefit at all. The words that I Myself have spoken to you are spirit and life.
verses.6:65: But there are some among you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning which ones did not believe, and who was going to betray Him.
verses.6:66: And He was saying, "For this reason I have told you that no one is able to come to Me unless it has been given to him by My Father."
verses.6:67: From this time many of His disciples went back and were no longer walking with Him.
verses.6:68: Jesus therefore said to the twelve, "You do not also want to depart, do you?"
verses.6:69: Therefore Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom will we go? You have words of eternal life,
verses.6:70: and we have believed and come to know that You are the Christ, the Son of God."
verses.6:71: Jesus replied to them, "Did I not choose you twelve, and yet one of you is a devil?"
verses.6:72: Now He was speaking of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, for he was going to betray Him, although he was one of the twelve.
verses.7:1: Now after these things, Jesus was walking about in Galilee, for He did not want to walk about in Judea, because the Jews were seeking to kill Him.
verses.7:2: Now the feast of the Jews, Tabernacles, was close at hand.
verses.7:3: Then His brothers said to Him, "Depart from here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples too may see Your works that You are doing.
verses.7:4: For indeed no one does anything in secret and himself seeks to be in the open. If You do these things, reveal Yourself to the world."
verses.7:5: For even His brothers were not believing in Him.
verses.7:6: Therefore Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet arrived, but your time is always ready.
verses.7:7: The world cannot hate you, yet it hates Me, because I bear witness concerning it that its works are evil.
verses.7:8: You go up to this feast; I, however, am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet been fulfilled."
verses.7:9: When He had said these things, He Himself remained in Galilee.
verses.7:10: Yet once His brothers went up, then He Himself also went up to the feast, not publicly, but as though in secret.
verses.7:11: Therefore the Jews were seeking Him at the feast and kept saying, "Where is He?"
verses.7:12: And there was much murmuring in the crowd about Him. For some were saying, "He is good." Others, however, were saying, "No, instead He leads the crowds astray."
verses.7:13: Still, no one was speaking openly about Him because of fear of the Jews.
verses.7:14: Now when the feast was already halfway through, Jesus went up into the temple and was teaching.
verses.7:15: And the Jews were amazed, saying, "How does this man know letters, though He has not studied?"
verses.7:16: Jesus answered them and said, "My teaching is not Mine, but that of Him who sent Me.
verses.7:17: If anyone wills to do His will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or I am speaking from Myself.
verses.7:18: The one who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; yet the one who seeks the glory of the one who sent him, this one is truthful, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.7:19: Did Moses not give you the law, and yet not one of you does the law?
verses.7:20: Why are you seeking to kill Me?" The crowd answered and said, "You have a demon; who is seeking to kill You?"
verses.7:21: Jesus answered and said to them, "I did one work, and all of you are amazed.
verses.7:22: Therefore Moses gave you circumcision (not that it comes from Moses, but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.
verses.7:23: If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses is not broken, are you indignant with Me because I made a whole man well on the Sabbath?
verses.7:24: Do not judge by appearance; rather, judge a righteous judgment."
verses.7:25: Therefore some from Jerusalem were saying, "Is this not the one whom they are seeking to kill?
verses.7:26: And look, He is speaking openly, and they say nothing to Him. Could the rulers truly have come to know that this is the Christ?
verses.7:27: Yet we know where this man is from; when the Christ comes, however, no one knows where He is from."
verses.7:28: Therefore Jesus was crying out as He taught in the temple, saying, "You know Me, and you also know where I am from; and I did not come from Myself, yet He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.
verses.7:29: I know Him, for I am from Him, and He Himself sent Me."
verses.7:30: Therefore they were seeking to seize Him, yet no one laid hands on Him, because His hour had not yet arrived.
verses.7:31: Yet many from the crowd believed in Him and were saying, "When the Christ comes, will He really do more signs than the ones this man is doing?"
verses.7:32: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things about Him, and the rulers and the Pharisees sent officers to seize Him.
verses.7:33: Therefore Jesus said to them, "I am still with you for a short time, and I am going to Him who sent Me.
verses.7:34: You will seek Me, and you will not find Me; and where I am, you are not able to come."
verses.7:35: Therefore the Jews said among themselves, "Where is this man about to go, that we will not find Him? Is He really about to go to the dispersion of the Gentiles and teach the Gentiles?
verses.7:36: What is this saying that He spoke, 'You will seek Me, and you will not find Me; and where I am, you are not able to come'?"
verses.7:37: Now on the last, great day of the festival, Jesus was standing and crying out, saying, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
verses.7:38: Whoever believes in Me, just as Scripture says, rivers of living water will flow from his belly."
verses.7:39: Now He said this concerning the Spirit, whom those believing in Him were about to receive; for the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
verses.7:40: Therefore some from that crowd, when they had heard these sayings of His, were saying, "This man is truly the Prophet."
verses.7:41: Others were saying, "This man is the Christ." Yet some were saying, "Does the Christ really come from Galilee?
verses.7:42: Does Scripture not say that the Christ comes from the seed of David, and from the village of Bethlehem, where David was?"
verses.7:43: Thus a dissension arose in the crowd on account of Him.
verses.7:44: Now some from among them wished to seize Him, yet no one laid hands upon Him.
verses.7:45: Therefore the officers came to the chief priests and the Pharisees. And they said to them, "Why did you not bring Him?"
verses.7:46: The officers answered, "Never has any man spoken like this man."
verses.7:47: Therefore the Pharisees answered them, "Have you also been led astray?
verses.7:48: Has anyone among the rulers believed in Him, or among the Pharisees?
verses.7:49: Yet this crowd, which does not know the law, is cursed."
verses.7:50: Nicodemus, the one who came to Him by night, who was one of them, said to them,
verses.7:51: "Does our law really judge a man unless it first hears from him and learns what he is doing?"
verses.7:52: They answered and said to him, "Are you a Galilean too? Search the Scriptures and see that no prophet arises from Galilee."
verses.7:53: And each one returned to his own house.
verses.8:1: But Jesus proceeded to the Mount of Olives.
verses.8:2: And at daybreak He came again into the temple, and all the people came to Him; and sitting down, He was teaching them.
verses.8:3: Then the scribes and the Pharisees bring a woman caught in adultery, and they stood her in the middle,
verses.8:4: and said to Him, "Teacher, this woman has just now been caught in adultery.
verses.8:5: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such women. What therefore do You say?"
verses.8:6: Yet they were saying this to test Him, so that they might be able to accuse Him. But Jesus, stooping downward, was writing with His finger on the ground.
verses.8:7: So when they persisted in questioning Him, He stood upright and said to them, "Let the one among you who is without sin cast a stone at her first."
verses.8:8: And stooping down again, He was writing on the ground.
verses.8:9: Then hearing this, they went out one after another, beginning with the elders; and Jesus remained alone, with the woman standing in the middle.
verses.8:10: Then raising Himself up, Jesus said to her, "Woman, where are those who were accusing you? Has no one condemned you?"
verses.8:11: She said, "No one, Lord." Then Jesus said, "Neither will I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more."
verses.8:12: So Jesus spoke to them again, saying, "I am the light of the world; the one who follows Me does not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."
verses.8:13: So the Pharisees said to Him, "You bear testimony about Yourself; Your testimony is not true."
verses.8:14: Jesus answered and said to them, "Even if I bear testimony about Myself, My testimony is true, because I know where I came from and where I am going; yet you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
verses.8:15: You judge according to the flesh; I do not judge anyone;
verses.8:16: and if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the One who sent Me, the Father.
verses.8:17: And it is written in your law that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.8:18: I am the One who bears testimony about Myself, and the One who sent Me, the Father, bears testimony about Me."
verses.8:19: So they were saying to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither Me nor My Father; if you knew Me, perhaps you would also know My Father."
verses.8:20: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, teaching in the temple, and no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
verses.8:21: Then Jesus said to them again, "I am going away, and you will seek Me, and in your sin you will die. Where I am going, you are not able to come."
verses.8:22: So the Jews were saying, "Surely He will not kill Himself, because He said, 'Where I am going, you are not able to come'?"
verses.8:23: And He was saying to them, "You are from below; I am from above. You are from this world; I am not from this world.
verses.8:24: Therefore I told you that you will die in your sins; for if you do not believe that I am, you will die in your sin."
verses.8:25: So they were saying to Him, "Who are You?" Jesus said to them, "The Beginning, who also speak to you.
verses.8:26: I have many things to speak and to judge about you, yet the One who sent Me is truthful; and the things I heard from Him, these I speak in the world."
verses.8:27: And they did not understand that He was calling God His Father.
verses.8:28: So Jesus said to them, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am, and I do nothing from Myself, but just as the Father taught Me, I speak these things;
verses.8:29: and the One who sent Me is with Me, and He has not left Me alone, because I always do the things pleasing to Him."
verses.8:30: While He was speaking these things, many believed in Him.
verses.8:31: So Jesus was saying to those Jews who believed Him, "If you remain in My word, you will truly be My disciples,
verses.8:32: and you will come to know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
verses.8:33: They answered Him, "We are Abraham's seed, and we have never been slaves to anyone; how do You say, 'You will be free'?"
verses.8:34: Jesus answered them, "Amen, amen, I tell you that everyone who commits sin is a slave of sin.
verses.8:35: Now a slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains forever.
verses.8:36: Therefore, if the Son sets you free, you will truly be free.
verses.8:37: I know that you are sons of Abraham, yet you seek to kill Me, because My word finds no room in you.
verses.8:38: I speak what I saw with My Father, and you do the things you saw with your father."
verses.8:39: They answered and said to Him, "Our father is Abraham." Jesus said to them, "If you are sons of Abraham, do the works of Abraham.
verses.8:40: But now you seek to kill Me, a man who has spoken to you the truth that I heard from God; Abraham did not do this.
verses.8:41: You do the works of your father." Therefore they said to Him, "We were not born from fornication; we have one Father, God."
verses.8:42: Jesus therefore said to them, "If God were your Father, you would certainly love Me as well; for I proceeded from God and came; for I did not come from Myself either, but He sent Me.
verses.8:43: Why do you not understand My speech? Because you are not able to hear My word.
verses.8:44: You are from your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and he did not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own, because he is a liar and the father of it.
verses.8:45: But if I speak the truth, you do not believe Me.
verses.8:46: Which of you will convict Me of sin? If I speak the truth to you, why do you not believe Me?
verses.8:47: The one who is from God hears the words of God. For this reason you do not hear, because you are not from God."
verses.8:48: The Jews therefore answered and said to Him, "Do we not rightly say that You are a Samaritan and have a demon?"
verses.8:49: Jesus answered, "I do not have a demon, but I honor My Father, and you have dishonored Me.
verses.8:50: I, however, do not seek My glory; there is One who seeks and judges.
verses.8:51: Amen, amen, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death."
verses.8:52: Therefore the Jews said, "Now we know that You have a demon. Abraham died, and so did the prophets; and You say, 'If anyone keeps My word, he will never taste death.'
verses.8:53: You are not greater than our father Abraham, who died, are You? And the prophets died. Who do You make Yourself?"
verses.8:54: Jesus answered, "If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing; it is My Father who glorifies Me, about whom you say that He is your God,
verses.8:55: and you have not come to know Him, yet I know Him. And if I say that I do not know Him, I will be like you, a liar. But I know Him, and I keep His word.
verses.8:56: Abraham, your father, exulted to see My day; he saw it and was glad."
verses.8:57: The Jews therefore said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?"
verses.8:58: Jesus said to them, "Amen, amen, I tell you, before Abraham came into being, I am."
verses.8:59: They therefore took up stones to throw at Him, yet Jesus hid Himself and went out from the temple.
verses.9:1: And passing by, Jesus saw a man blind from birth.
verses.9:2: And His disciples asked Him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, so that he was born blind?"
verses.9:3: Jesus answered, "Neither did this man sin nor his parents, but so that the works of God may be manifested in him.
verses.9:4: I must work the works of Him who sent Me while it is day; night is coming, when no one is able to work.
verses.9:5: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
verses.9:6: When He had said these things, He spat on the ground, and made mud from the saliva, and spread the mud over his eyes.
verses.9:7: And He said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which is interpreted "Sent"). Therefore he went away, and washed, and came back seeing.
verses.9:8: Accordingly, the neighbors and those who had previously seen that he was a beggar were saying, "Is this not the one who used to sit and beg?" Others were saying, "This is he."
verses.9:9: Others, however, were saying, "Not at all, but he resembles him." Yet he kept saying, "I am he."
verses.9:10: Therefore they were saying to him, "How were your eyes opened?"
verses.9:11: He answered, "That man who is called Jesus made mud, and anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.' And I went away, and washed, and I see."
verses.9:12: And they said to him, "Where is He?" He said, "I do not know."
verses.9:13: They bring the one who had been blind to the Pharisees.
verses.9:14: Now it was the Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.9:15: Therefore the Pharisees were asking him again how he had seen. And he said to them, "He placed mud on my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
verses.9:16: Therefore some of the Pharisees were saying, "This man who does not keep the Sabbath is not from God." Others, however, were saying, "How can a sinful man do these signs?" And there was a division among them.
verses.9:17: Therefore they say to the blind man again, "What do you say about Him who opened your eyes?" And he said, "He is a prophet."
verses.9:18: Therefore the Jews did not believe concerning him that he had been blind and had seen, until they called the parents of the one who had seen.
verses.9:19: And they asked them, saying, "Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he see now?"
verses.9:20: His parents replied to them and said, "We know that this is our son and that he was born blind;
verses.9:21: but how he sees now, we do not know; or who opened his eyes, we ourselves do not know. Ask him; he is of age; let him speak for himself."
verses.9:22: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already conspired that if anyone confessed Him to be the Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.9:23: Because of this, his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
verses.9:24: Therefore they again called the man who had been blind, and said to him, "Give glory to God; we know that this man is a sinner."
verses.9:25: Therefore he said to them, "Whether He is a sinner, I do not know; one thing I know, that although I was blind, I now see."
verses.9:26: Therefore they said to him, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"
verses.9:27: He answered them, "I have already told you, and you heard; why do you want to hear it again? You do not also want to become His disciples, do you?"
verses.9:28: Therefore they cursed him and said, "You be His disciple; we, however, are disciples of Moses.
verses.9:29: We know that God spoke to Moses, yet as for this one, we do not know where He is from."
verses.9:30: That man answered and said to them, "Indeed, in this is an astonishing thing, that you do not know where He is from, and He opened my eyes.
verses.9:31: Now we know that God does not hear sinners; rather, if anyone is a worshiper of God and does His will, He listens to him.
verses.9:32: Since time began, it has not been heard that anyone opened the eyes of one born blind.
verses.9:33: If He were not from God, He could not do anything."
verses.9:34: They answered and said to him, "You were born completely in sins, and are you teaching us?" And they threw him outside.
verses.9:35: Jesus heard that they had thrown him outside, and when He had found him, He said to him, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"
verses.9:36: He answered and said, "Who is He, Lord, so that I may believe in Him?"
verses.9:37: And Jesus said to him, "You have both seen Him, and the one who speaks with you is He Himself."
verses.9:38: And he said, "I believe, Lord." And falling prostrate, he worshiped Him.
verses.9:39: And Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind."
verses.9:40: And some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard and said to Him, "We are not also blind, are we?"
verses.9:41: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would not have sin. But now you say, 'We see'; your sin remains."
verses.10:1: "Amen, amen, I tell you, the one who does not enter through the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbs up from another place, that one is a thief and a robber.
verses.10:2: But the one who enters through the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.10:3: For him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and brings them out.
verses.10:4: And when he has sent out his own sheep, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.
verses.10:5: A stranger, however, they do not follow, but flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers."
verses.10:6: Jesus told them this proverb, but they did not understand what He was speaking to them.
verses.10:7: Therefore Jesus said to them again, "Amen, amen, I tell you that I am the door of the sheep.
verses.10:8: All, as many as came, are thieves and robbers, and the sheep did not listen to them.
verses.10:9: I am the door. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved, and he will go in and go out, and he will find pastures.
verses.10:10: The thief does not come except to steal and slaughter and destroy. I have come so that they may have life, and have it more abundantly.
verses.10:11: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives his life for his sheep.
verses.10:12: But the hired worker, who is not a shepherd and whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming and abandons the sheep and flees, and the wolf snatches and scatters the sheep.
verses.10:13: Now the hired worker flees because he is a hired worker, and the sheep are of no concern to him.
verses.10:14: I am the good shepherd; and I know My own, and My own know Me.
verses.10:15: Just as the Father knows Me, I also know the Father; and I lay down My life for My sheep.
verses.10:16: And I have other sheep that are not from this fold; I must bring those also, and they will hear My voice, and there will be one fold and one shepherd.
verses.10:17: Therefore the Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I may take it up again.
verses.10:18: No one takes it away from Me, but I lay it down of Myself; and I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. I received this command from My Father."
verses.10:19: Again a division arose among the Jews on account of these words.
verses.10:20: Now many among them were saying, "He has a demon and is insane; why are you listening to Him?"
verses.10:21: Others were saying, "These words are not those of one who has a demon. Can a demon really open the eyes of the blind?"
verses.10:22: Now the Festival of Dedication took place in Jerusalem, and it was winter.
verses.10:23: And Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's portico.
verses.10:24: Therefore the Jews surrounded Him and were saying to Him, "How long are You keeping our soul in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."
verses.10:25: Jesus answered them, "I speak to you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in My Father's name, these bear witness about Me.
verses.10:26: But you do not believe, because you are not among My sheep.
verses.10:27: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me;
verses.10:28: and I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will snatch them from My hand.
verses.10:29: What My Father has given Me is greater than all, and no one can snatch it from the hand of My Father.
verses.10:30: I and the Father are one."
verses.10:31: Therefore the Jews picked up stones to stone Him.
verses.10:32: Jesus answered them, "Many good works I have shown you from My Father; on account of which of those works are you stoning Me?"
verses.10:33: The Jews answered Him, "We are not stoning You for a good work, but for blasphemy, and because You, though You are a man, make Yourself God."
verses.10:34: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your law, 'I have said, you are gods'?
verses.10:35: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came, and the Scripture cannot be broken,
verses.10:36: of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, do you say, 'You are blaspheming,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God'?
verses.10:37: If I am not doing the works of My Father, do not believe Me.
verses.10:38: But if I am doing them, even if you are not willing to believe Me, believe the works, so that you may know and believe that the Father is in Me, and I in the Father."
verses.10:39: Therefore they were seeking to seize Him, and He escaped from their hands.
verses.10:40: And He went away again across the Jordan, to that place where John was baptizing at first, and He stayed there.
verses.10:41: And many came to Him and were saying, "John indeed performed no sign.
verses.10:42: Yet all things that John said about this man were true." And many believed in Him.
verses.11:1: Now there was a certain ailing man, Lazarus from Bethany, from the village of Mary and Martha her sister.
verses.11:2: (Now Mary was the one who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was ill.)
verses.11:3: Therefore his sisters sent to Him, saying, "Lord, look, the one You love is ill."
verses.11:4: Now upon hearing this, Jesus said to them, "This illness is not for death, but for the glory of God, so that through it the Son of God may be glorified."
verses.11:5: And Jesus loved Martha, her sister Mary, and Lazarus.
verses.11:6: Therefore, when He heard that he was ill, He then indeed remained in the same place for two days;
verses.11:7: then after these things He said to His disciples, "Let us go into Judea again."
verses.11:8: The disciples said to Him, "Rabbi, just now the Jews were seeking to stone You, and You are going there again?"
verses.11:9: Jesus replied, "Are there not twelve hours of the day? If someone walks during the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world;
verses.11:10: but if he walks during the night, he stumbles, because light is not in him."
verses.11:11: He spoke these things, and after this He said to them, "Lazarus, our friend, is sleeping; but I am going so that I may rouse him from sleep."
verses.11:12: Therefore His disciples said, "Lord, if he is sleeping, he will be well."
verses.11:13: Now Jesus had spoken about his death, but they supposed that He was speaking about the slumber of sleep.
verses.11:14: So then Jesus said to them plainly, "Lazarus has died,
verses.11:15: and I rejoice on your account, so that you may believe, that I was not there; but let us go to him."
verses.11:16: So Thomas, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, "Let us go as well, so that we may die with Him."
verses.11:17: And so Jesus came and found him already four days in the tomb.
verses.11:18: (Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.)
verses.11:19: Now many from among the Jews had come to Martha and Mary so that they might comfort them about their brother.
verses.11:20: Therefore, when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet Him; Mary, however, was sitting at home.
verses.11:21: Then Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died;
verses.11:22: yet even now I know that whatever You ask from God, God will give to You."
verses.11:23: Jesus told her, "Your brother will rise again."
verses.11:24: Martha told Him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection on the last day."
verses.11:25: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life; the one who believes in Me, even if he dies, will live;
verses.11:26: and every person who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?"
verses.11:27: She said to Him, "Yes, Lord, I have believed that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God, who have come into this world."
verses.11:28: And when she had said these things, she went away and quietly called Mary her sister, saying, "The Teacher is here and is calling you."
verses.11:29: As soon as she heard it, she rose quickly and came to Him;
verses.11:30: for Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still in that place where Martha had met Him.
verses.11:31: Therefore the Jews who were with her in the house and were comforting her, when they saw that Mary rose quickly and went out, followed her, saying, "She is going to the tomb to weep there."
verses.11:32: So when Mary had come where Jesus was, seeing Him, she fell at His feet and said to Him, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died."
verses.11:33: Therefore, when Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her weeping, He groaned in spirit and troubled Himself,
verses.11:34: and said, "Where have you placed him?" They said to Him, "Lord, come and see."
verses.11:36: Therefore the Jews said, "Look how He loved him!"
verses.11:37: Some of them, however, said, "Could not this man, who opened the eyes of the one born blind, have brought it about that this man would not die?"
verses.11:38: Therefore Jesus, groaning within Himself again, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone had been placed over it.
verses.11:39: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of the one who had died, said to Him, "Lord, he already gives off a stench, for he is four days dead."
verses.11:40: Jesus told her, "Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?"
verses.11:41: Therefore they took away the stone; and Jesus, having lifted His eyes upward, said, "Father, I give thanks to You that You have heard Me.
verses.11:42: And I knew that You always hear Me, yet on account of the people who are standing around I spoke, so that they may believe that You have sent Me."
verses.11:43: After He had said these things, He called out in a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"
verses.11:44: And immediately the one who had died came out, his feet and hands bound with wrappings, and his face was bound with a face cloth. Jesus said to them, "Untie him and let him go."
verses.11:45: Therefore many from among the Jews who had come to Mary and Martha, and had seen the things Jesus did, believed in Him.
verses.11:46: Some of them, however, went away to the Pharisees and told them the things Jesus did.
verses.11:47: So the chief priests and the Pharisees assembled a council and were saying, "What are we doing, since this man performs many signs?
verses.11:48: If we leave Him alone like this, all will believe in Him, and the Romans will come and take away our place and nation."
verses.11:49: One of them, however, Caiaphas by name, since he was high priest of that year, said to them, "You do not know anything,
verses.11:50: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for you that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation should not perish."
verses.11:51: Now he did not say this on his own, but since he was high priest of that year, he prophesied that Jesus was about to die for the nation,
verses.11:52: and not only for the nation, but so that He might gather into one the children of God who were scattered.
verses.11:53: Therefore from that day they plotted to kill Him.
verses.11:54: Therefore Jesus no longer walked openly among the Jews, but went away into the region near the desert, into a city that is called Ephraim, and there He stayed with His disciples.
verses.11:55: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the countryside before the Passover, so that they might sanctify themselves.
verses.11:56: Therefore they were seeking Jesus, and standing in the temple they were talking with one another, "What do you think, that He is not coming to the feast day?" Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a command that if anyone found out where He was, he should disclose it, so that they might seize Him.
verses.12:1: Therefore, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus had been dead, whom Jesus raised.
verses.12:2: Now they made a dinner for Him there, and Martha was serving, while Lazarus was one of those reclining with Him.
verses.12:3: Then Mary took a pound of costly ointment of genuine nard, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped His feet with her hair; and the house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.12:4: Then one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was about to betray Him, said,
verses.12:5: "Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the needy?"
verses.12:6: Now he said this, not because he cared about the needy, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, he carried the things that were put in.
verses.12:7: Therefore Jesus said, "Leave her alone, so that she may keep it for the day of My burial.
verses.12:8: For the poor you always have with you, but Me you do not always have."
verses.12:9: Then a large crowd of the Jews learned that He was there, and they came, not only on account of Jesus, but so that they might see Lazarus, whom He raised from the dead.
verses.12:10: Now the chief priests planned to kill Lazarus as well,
verses.12:11: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away and believing in Jesus.
verses.12:12: Now on the next day, a large crowd that had come to the feast day, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.12:13: took palm branches and went out to meet Him, and were shouting, "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord, King of Israel!"
verses.12:14: And Jesus found a young donkey and sat upon it, just as it is written:
verses.12:15: "Do not be afraid, daughter of Zion; look, your King is coming, sitting upon the colt of a female donkey."
verses.12:16: His disciples did not understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things had been written about Him and that they had done these things to Him.
verses.12:17: Therefore the crowd that was with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was bearing witness.
verses.12:18: For this reason also the crowd came to meet Him, because they heard that He had done this sign.
verses.12:19: Therefore the Pharisees said to themselves, "Do you see that we are accomplishing nothing? Look, the whole world has gone after Him!"
verses.12:20: Now there were certain Gentiles among those who had gone up to worship on the feast day.
verses.12:21: So these approached Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and were asking him, saying, "Sir, we want to see Jesus."
verses.12:22: Philip came and told Andrew; and in turn Andrew and Philip told Jesus.
verses.12:23: But Jesus answered them, saying, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.12:24: Amen, amen, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat, falling into the ground, dies,
verses.12:25: it remains by itself alone; but if it dies, it yields much fruit. The one who loves his life will lose it, and the one who hates his life in this world keeps it for eternal life.
verses.12:26: If anyone serves Me, let him follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will also be. If anyone serves Me, My Father will honor him.
verses.12:27: Now My soul is troubled. And what shall I say? Father, save Me from this hour. Yet for this reason I came to this hour:
verses.12:28: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came from heaven: "I have both glorified it, and I will glorify it again."
verses.12:29: Therefore the crowd that was standing by and had heard was saying that there had been thunder. Others were saying, "An angel has spoken to Him."
verses.12:30: Jesus answered and said, "This voice did not come on account of Me, but on account of you.
verses.12:31: Now is the judgment of the world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
verses.12:32: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all things to Myself."
verses.12:33: (Now He was saying this, signifying by what death He was going to die.)
verses.12:34: The crowd answered Him, "We have heard from the law that the Christ remains forever; and how do You say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this Son of Man?"
verses.12:35: Therefore Jesus said to them, "For a little while longer, the light is among you. Walk while you have the light, so that darkness may not overtake you; and the one who walks in darkness does not know where he is going.
verses.12:36: While you have the light, believe in the light, so that you may be sons of light." Jesus spoke these things, and He went away and hid Himself from them.
verses.12:37: Yet although He had performed so many signs before them, they were not believing in Him,
verses.12:38: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: "Lord, who believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
verses.12:39: For this reason they were not able to believe, because Isaiah said again:
verses.12:40: "He blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they might not see with their eyes, and might not understand with their heart, and turn back, and I would heal them."
verses.12:41: Isaiah said these things when he saw His glory and spoke about Him.
verses.12:42: Nevertheless, even among the rulers many believed in Him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing it, so that they would not be cast out of the synagogue.
verses.12:43: For they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God.
verses.12:44: Now Jesus cried out and said, "The one who believes in Me does not believe in Me, but in Him who sent Me.
verses.12:45: And the one who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.
verses.12:46: I have come as light into the world, so that everyone who believes in Me may not remain in darkness.
verses.12:47: And if anyone hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him; for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.12:48: The one who spurns Me and does not receive My words has one who judges him. The word that I have spoken, it will judge him on the last day.
verses.12:49: Because I have not spoken from Myself, but He who sent Me, the Father, Himself gave Me a commandment: what I should say and what I should speak.
verses.12:50: And I know that His commandment is eternal life; therefore, the things that I speak, just as the Father told Me, so I speak."
verses.13:1: Before the feast day of the Passover, knowing that His hour had come to pass from this world to the Father, since He had loved His own who were in the world, Jesus loved them to the end.
verses.13:2: And when supper had been made, the devil having already put it into the heart that Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, should betray Him,
verses.13:3: knowing that the Father had given all things into His hands, and that He had come forth from God and was going to God,
verses.13:4: He rose from supper and laid aside His garments, and after He had taken a linen towel, He wrapped it around His waist.
verses.13:5: Then He poured water into a basin and began to wash the feet of the disciples and to wipe them with the linen towel that was wrapped around His waist.
verses.13:6: So He came to Simon Peter. And Peter said to Him, "Lord, are You washing my feet?"
verses.13:7: Jesus answered and said to him, "What I am doing you do not know now, but you will know afterward."
verses.13:8: Peter said to Him, "You will never wash my feet." Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you will have no share with Me."
verses.13:9: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, not only my feet, but also my hands and my head."
verses.13:10: Jesus said to him, "The one who has been washed has no need except to wash his feet, but is entirely clean. And you are clean, but not all of you."
verses.13:11: For He knew who it was who would betray Him; for this reason He said, "You are not all clean."
verses.13:12: So after He had washed their feet and taken His garments, when He had reclined again, He said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.13:13: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and you speak rightly, for indeed I am.
verses.13:14: Therefore, if I, the Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash the feet of one another.
verses.13:15: For I have given you an example, so that just as I have done to you, you also should do.
verses.13:16: Amen, amen, I tell you: a servant is not greater than his master, nor is an apostle greater than the one who sent him.
verses.13:17: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
verses.13:18: I am not speaking about all of you; I know those whom I have chosen, but so that the Scripture may be fulfilled: 'The one who eats bread with Me will lift up his heel against Me.'
verses.13:19: From now on I am telling you before it takes place, so that when it has taken place, you may believe that I am.
verses.13:20: Amen, amen, I tell you: the one who receives anyone whom I send receives Me; and the one who receives Me receives Him who sent Me."
verses.13:21: When Jesus had said these things, He was troubled in spirit, and He testified and said, "Amen, amen, I tell you that one of you will betray Me."
verses.13:22: So the disciples were looking at one another, uncertain about whom He was speaking.
verses.13:23: Now one of His disciples was reclining at the bosom of Jesus, the one whom Jesus loved.
verses.13:24: So Simon Peter motioned to him and said to him, "Who is it about whom He is speaking?"
verses.13:25: Therefore, when he had leaned back upon the chest of Jesus, he said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"
verses.13:26: Jesus answered, "It is the one to whom I hand the dipped bread." And when He had dipped the bread, He gave it to Judas, son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.13:27: And after the morsel, Satan entered into him. And Jesus said to him, "What you are doing, do more quickly."
verses.13:28: Now none of those reclining knew for what purpose He said this to him.
verses.13:29: For some were thinking, because Judas had the moneybox, that Jesus had said to him, "Buy the things that we need for the feast day," or that he should give something to the needy.
verses.13:30: So when he had received the morsel, he went out immediately. And it was night.
verses.13:31: So when he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in Him.
verses.13:32: If God has been glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and He will glorify Him immediately.
verses.13:33: Little children, I am with you a little while longer. You will seek Me; and just as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you cannot come,' I also tell you now.
verses.13:34: I give you a new commandment: that you love one another; just as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
verses.13:35: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another."
verses.13:36: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, where are You going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow afterward."
verses.13:37: Peter said to Him, "Why can I not follow You now? I will lay down my life for You."
verses.13:38: Jesus answered him, "Will you lay down your life for Me? Amen, amen, I tell you: the rooster will not crow until you deny Me three times."
verses.14:1: "Do not let your heart be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in Me.
verses.14:2: In My Father's house there are many dwelling places; if it were not so, I would have told you, because I am going to prepare a place for you.
verses.14:3: And if I go away and prepare a place for you, I am coming again and will receive you to Myself, so that where I am, you also may be.
verses.14:4: And you know where I am going, and you know the way."
verses.14:5: Thomas said to Him, "Lord, we do not know where You are going; and how can we know the way?"
verses.14:6: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father unless through Me.
verses.14:7: If you had known Me, you would certainly have known My Father as well; and from now on you will know Him, and you have seen Him."
verses.14:8: Philip said to Him, "Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us."
verses.14:9: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you for so long a time, and you have not known Me? Philip, the one who sees Me sees the Father also. How do you say, 'Show us the Father'?
verses.14:10: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The words that I speak to you I do not speak from Myself; rather, the Father remaining in Me, He Himself has done the works.
verses.14:11: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me?
verses.14:12: Otherwise, believe because of the works themselves. Amen, amen, I tell you, the one who believes in Me will also do the works that I do, and he will do greater than these, because I am going to the Father.
verses.14:13: And whatever you ask the Father in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.14:14: If you ask Me anything in My name, this I will do.
verses.14:15: If you love Me, keep My commandments;
verses.14:16: and I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Paraclete, so that He may remain with you forever,
verses.14:17: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him; but you will know Him, because He will remain with you and will be in you.
verses.14:18: I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you.
verses.14:19: A little while longer, and the world sees Me no longer. But you see Me; because I live, you also will live.
verses.14:20: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.
verses.14:21: The one who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. And the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him."
verses.14:22: Judas, not the Iscariot, said to Him, "Lord, what has happened that You are about to manifest Yourself to us, and not to the world?"
verses.14:23: Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make a dwelling place with him;
